#!/bin/bash
# AC6: blindness is enforced by the environment, never by a prompt check.
set -u
cd "$(pwd)" || exit 1
S=02-govern-plan/evolution-rollout/SKILL.md
fail=0
chk() { if [ "$2" = 0 ]; then echo "  PASS: $1"; else echo "  FAIL: $1"; fail=1; fi; }
has() { printf '%s' "$1" | grep -qE "$2"; }

n=$(grep -c '^```bash blindness-sandbox$' "$S"); [ "$n" = 1 ]; chk "exactly one fenced block with info string 'bash blindness-sandbox' (found $n)" $?

blk=$(awk '/^```bash blindness-sandbox$/{i=1;next} i&&/^```$/{i=0;next} i' "$S")
has "$blk" 'archive HEAD'; chk "the block snapshots HEAD with git archive (no .git, so history is unreachable)" $?
has "$blk" 'rm -rf "\$EXPORT/evolve"'; chk "the block denies the evolve/ path in the export" $?
has "$blk" 'deny evolve/'; chk "the block writes a blindness policy denying evolve/" $?
has "$blk" 'denied:'; chk "the block ships a reader that refuses a denied prefix before opening it" $?
if has "$blk" 'cp -R|rsync|tar -c|cp -a'; then chk "no working-tree copy in the block (which would carry .git)" 1; else chk "no working-tree copy in the block (which would carry .git)" 0; fi

grep -qF 'The prompt-grep gate is a cheap pre-check before the export' "$S"; chk "the record states the prompt-grep gate is a cheap pre-check only" $?
grep -qi 'environment' "$S"; chk "the record attributes enforcement to the environment" $?
echo "AC6 fails=$fail"
[ "$fail" -eq 0 ]

#!/bin/bash
# AC12: catalog.json serializes with the successor plan tswc-skills-lane-matrix:
# the three entries are present in the catalog's canonical sorted order, each with
# exactly the declared keys, so the successor's rebase is a single hunks set.
